Risk addressed: An extract lands incomplete or duplicated, so reported totals are wrong while looking plausible.
Description: Source-to-raw completeness: row count and value total per extract are compared against the control-totals trailer file written beside it.
Test procedure: Plant duplicate_goods_receipt and truncated_extract; confirm the run fails, the publish is blocked, and the manifest count matches what the control reported.

Risk addressed: Rows are silently lost or multiplied between warehouse layers, usually by a join that changes grain.
Description: Raw-to-mart completeness: keys are reconciled layer by layer so no row is dropped or duplicated between raw, staging, intermediate, and marts.
Test procedure: Introduce a deliberately duplicating join in a branch; confirm the control fails and names the layer.

Risk addressed: Inventory on the balance sheet disagrees with the movements that produced it, so the reported inventory value is unsupported.
Description: Inventory subledger to GL: inventory value derived from goods movements is compared against the GL inventory account balance, per period, at standard cost.
Test procedure: Run with defects off and confirm a zero difference; plant backdated_gl_posting and uom_mismatch and confirm the difference is reported and the publish blocked.

Risk addressed: A supplier is paid for goods that were never ordered or never received, or at a price nobody agreed.
Description: Three-way match: PO line, goods receipt, and supplier invoice must agree on quantity and price within tolerance.
Test procedure: Plant receipt_without_po and invoice_price_outlier; confirm each is reported and matches the manifest exactly.

Risk addressed: Production output reported to finance does not match what the factory actually built and tested.
Description: MES to ERP: units passing final test are compared against production order confirmations, per period.
Test procedure: Plant mes_erp_completion_gap and late_arriving_mes_events; confirm both are reported with the period affected.

Risk addressed: A posting enters a period that has already been closed and reported, restating published figures.
Description: Closed-period integrity: no posting may carry a posting date inside a closed period, where close is defined by the configured close lag.
Test procedure: Plant backdated_gl_posting; confirm the run fails, the publish is blocked, and reporting keeps the previous dataset.

Risk addressed: A standard cost is changed without authorisation, silently revaluing inventory and distorting margin.
Description: Standard cost change approval: every change in the SCD Type 2 standard cost snapshot must have a matching approval record.
Test procedure: Plant unapproved_standard_cost_change; confirm the control reports exactly the planted changes and no approved ones.

Risk addressed: A source feed stops arriving and the dashboard keeps showing old numbers as if they were current.
Description: Source freshness: every extract must have arrived within its declared refresh window. A stale source blocks publishing of the metrics it feeds.
Test procedure: Plant stale_extract; confirm the affected metrics are blocked and the trust status shows them as untrusted.

Risk addressed: A fact references a dimension member that does not exist, so it is dropped from or double-counted in a report.
Description: Referential integrity: dbt relationship and not-null tests on every fact-to-dimension key.
Test procedure: Plant orphaned_po_lines and missing_supplier_on_shipment; confirm the dbt build fails and names the failing relationship.

Risk addressed: Reported on-hand inventory goes negative, which is physically impossible and indicates a sequencing or duplication error.
Description: Non-negative inventory: a custom dbt test asserts no material shows a negative on-hand balance in any period.
Test procedure: Plant negative_on_hand; confirm the test fails and the exception appears on the Inventory dashboard page.

Risk addressed: A quantity recorded in the wrong unit of measure misstates inventory value, often by an order of magnitude.
Description: Unit-of-measure consistency: quantities are standardised in staging and a test asserts each material uses one base unit across all sources.
Test procedure: Plant uom_mismatch; confirm the control reports the affected component and the subledger-to-GL difference it causes.

Risk addressed: A change reaches the certified dataset without review, tests, or traceability to an approved story.
Description: Change management: branch protection on main, required CI status checks (lint, tests, dbt build, reconciliations), and a CI check that fails a PR title without a Jira key.
Evidence location: GitHub branch protection settings; CI run history; CHANGELOG.md
Test procedure: Attempt a direct push to main and confirm it is rejected; open a PR with no Jira key in the title and confirm CI fails.
Status: Partially implemented - no second approver. See ADR-011.

Risk addressed: Someone holds more database access than their function needs, or retains access after it is no longer required.
Description: Logical access: four least-privilege roles (loader, transformer, reporter, auditor) with PUBLIC privileges revoked, plus a dated user access review generated from live Postgres grants.
Test procedure: Assert each role is denied what it should not reach: reporter cannot read raw or sandbox, loader cannot read reporting, auditor cannot read business data. Diff the access review against the previous one.

Risk addressed: The record of what the pipeline did is altered after the fact, destroying the audit trail.
Description: Append-only audit trail: audit.pipeline_runs records one row per file per run with run ID, batch ID, git SHA, file hash, and row counts. UPDATE and DELETE are revoked from every role and a trigger raises on any attempt.
Test procedure: Attempt UPDATE and DELETE on audit.pipeline_runs as each role and confirm both are refused at both layers. Note that a superuser can still bypass this - a documented limitation.

Risk addressed: A certified number reaches a leader without the evidence needed to show it is complete and accurate.
Description: IPE evidence pack: each certified run writes evidence/<run_id>/ with parameters, query text and hash, source row counts, control totals, reconciliation results, git SHA, timestamp, and the role that ran it.
Test procedure: Pick a number from the dashboard and trace it to its evidence pack; confirm the pack reproduces the number and the pack's git SHA matches the run.

Risk addressed: A validated build is never published, or a failed build is published, so the dashboard shows an inconsistent or unvalidated dataset.
Description: Publish gate: models build into publish_candidate and are swapped into reporting only when every critical check passes. On failure, reporting keeps the last good dataset and audit.publish_log records the reason.
Test procedure: Force a critical check failure and confirm reporting is unchanged, the publish log holds the reason, and the dashboard still shows its previous refresh time.

Risk addressed: A certified KPI's definition drifts from its implementation, so two reports using the same name disagree.
Description: Lineage integrity: column-level lineage is generated from compiled SQL, and CI fails when a certified KPI column cannot be fully resolved to raw source columns.
Test procedure: Rename a source column without updating the model and confirm CI fails naming the unresolved KPI column.
